subject: Secret pit near Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Head for the silver rock near the entrance to the Great Fairy's Fountain, pick it up with the Silver Gauntlets, and destroy the boulder underneath with bombs to reveal a pit.

evidence.quote:
Head for the silver rock near the entrance to the Great Fairy's Fountain.  With
the Silver Gauntlets, pick up the rock and throw it aside.  There is another
boulder underneath.  Destroy it with bombs (sometimes this boulder is already
destroyed from when you open the Fairy Fountain) to reveal a pit.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Inside the pit near the Great Fairy's Fountain, watch out for invisible Big Skulltulas on the ramp, and kill another Big Skulltula at the top of the ladder.

evidence.quote:
Drop down
the pit, and start heading up the ramp.  On the way, watch out for invisible
Big Skulltulas.  At the top of the ramp, climb up the ladder, and kill another
Big Skulltula at the top.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS097]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS097] is on the wall to the left of the ladder at the top of the ramp inside the pit near the Great Fairy's Fountain.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS097]...Drop down
the pit, and start heading up the ramp...The Gold Skulltula is on the wall to the left of the
ladder.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS026]
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth behind the Observatory causes Gold Skulltula #1 [GS026] to emerge.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS026]...Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth behind the Observatory.  The
Gold Skulltula will emerge from the patch.  Kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS035]
text: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS035] is located on the wall behind the Observatory, where you can stand on the wooden plank bridge and use the Boomerang to kill it.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS035]...Head around to the backside of the Observatory, where you are standing on the
wooden plank bridge suspended over the river from Gerudo Valley.  The Gold
Skulltula is on the wall on the back of the building.  Use the Boomerang to
kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS027]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS027] appears on one of the two small posts on the small island in the southeast of Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS027]...Swim out to the small island in the southeast of the Lake.  It's to the east of
the large island.  The Gold Skulltula will appear on one of the two small posts
on the island.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS078]
text: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS078] is found on top of the trunk of the dead tree on the large island, reached by using the Longshot to pull yourself up.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #4 [GS078]...Use the Longshot to pull yourself up to the top of the tree.  Aim for the bit
of the trunk which sticks up over the large branch.  Once at the top, kill the
Gold Skulltula on top of the trunk, and use the Longshot to take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS072]
text: Equipping the Iron Boots to drop to the bottom of the pool in the Observatory and rolling into a crate reveals Gold Skulltula #5 [GS072].

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #5 [GS072]...Equip the Iron Boots and drop to the bottom of the pool in the Observatory.  At
the bottom is a crate.  Roll into it, and it will shatter, revealing the game's
only underwater Gold Skulltula.  Kill it with the Longshot, then walk into the
token to take it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS037]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS037] can be seen above the waterfall to the right from halfway up the log bridge near the entrance from Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS037]...Head up the log bridge near the entrance from Hyrule Field.  Halfway up the
bridge, stop and look above the waterfall to the right to see the Gold
Skulltula.  Use the Boomerang to kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS028]
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth on the west side of the narrow strip of earth near the river at the bottom of the canyon reveals Gold Skulltula #2 [GS028].

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS028]...Head for the narrow strip of earth near the river at the bottom of the canyon.
On the west side of the strip of earth, there is a patch of soft earth.  Drop a
Bottled Bug into it, and kill the Gold Skulltula that emerges to get it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS087]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS087] is located on the wall behind the Carpenter's Tent and can be killed and collected with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS087]...Look on the wall behind the Carpenter's Tent to see the Gold Skulltula.  Kill
it and use the Hookshot to take the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS088]
text: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS088] is located on the inside of the stone arch across from the Carpenter's Tent to the left from the wooden bridge.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #4 [GS088]...Head for the stone arch across from the Carpenter's Tent, to the left from the
wooden bridge.  The Gold Skulltula is on the inside of the arch.  Kill it and
take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS089]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS089] is located on the wall between the gap of the two upper-most roofs on the top level of the Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS089]...Climb up to the top level of the Gerudo Fortress, to the gap between the two
upper-most roofs.  The Gold Skulltula is on the wall between this gap.  Kill it
and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS090]
text: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS090] is found on the lone target on the north side of the Horseback Archery Range.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS090]...Head for the north end of the Horseback Archery Range.  Look on the lone target
on the north side to see the Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with
the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS091]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS091] rests on the opposite wall in the small room at the bottom of the pit inside the opening on the south side of the building.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS091]...Enter the opening on the south side of the building, and drop down the pit
there.  In this small room, the Gold Skulltula rests on the opposite wall.
Kill it to get it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS092]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS092] is found halfway up the trunks of the Palm Trees near the dried-up Oasis.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS092]...Look halfway up the trunks of the Palm Trees near the dried-up Oasis to find a
Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS093]
text: Dropping a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth near the entrance to the Spirit Temple reveals Gold Skulltula #2 [GS093].

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS093]...Drop a Bottled Bug into the patch of soft earth near the entrance to the Spirit
Temple, and then kill the Gold Skulltula that emerges.  Take it's token.
